X.notes: Accurate constructor walkthrough with correct line cites; covers the default of 4, the size-capped segment loop, the weight split and UNSET_INT. Says eviction is per segment but omits the MAX_SEGMENTS clamp, segmentFor routing, evictEntries mechanics and the zero-expiry maxWeight=0 case. Its uncertainty section admits these gaps.

wrong_claims: Claims each segment gets at least about 20 entries of capacity; the loop checks before doubling, so the guarantee is about 10 (code comment at :281).
Y.notes: Broader coverage: MAX_SEGMENTS clamp, segmentFor routing, per-segment maxSegmentWeight field, eviction loop at :2672, initTable threshold bump. Citations accurate; the initTable threshold is cited as :1996 but is actually at :1999, within tolerance. Misses fact 5 (zero expiry leads to maxWeight 0 and a single segment).
